tooltip.mfqm.glue: Struggling weakens bonds but deepens sinking. Rest to hold your depth.
tooltip.mfqm.sticky_board: Reusable base. Coat with a glue bucket; repeated struggle wears out the glue.
message.mfqm.trapped: Press %s to struggle. Seek an edge or rescue; beware of sinking.
tooltip.mfqm.life_jacket: Buoyancy in supported sinking media. Sneak to disable; ineffective in glue.
tooltip.mfqm.wading_boots: Support in shallow compatible media; ineffective in deep media, glue or coated boards. Boots may be left behind in glue.
tooltip.mfqm.sticky_board.coated: Glue coating: %s/7. Place on solid ground to trap targets. Adjacent boards at the same height join into a larger board.
tooltip.mfqm.sticky_board.empty: No glue: this base cannot trap targets. Apply a glue bucket. Adjacent boards at the same height join into a larger board.
mfqm.configuration.strandDensity.tooltip: Client strand base per contact: 1-128, default 8. Per target, up to about 512 by default or 8192 at the maximum. Few contacts receive up to 4x density within the total budget. Stable random attachment, width, thickness and slight curvature; independent submerged roots with no branching. High values increase rendering cost. Physics is unchanged.
